assertions.name: A1_exact_but_not_ohtsuki_kappa1
assertions.source: A₁ = 1/3 + 17√3/108 i exact (50+ dps); A₁ ≠ Ohtsuki κ₁=11√3π/108 (best rel 0.633) ⇒ V=Li2(z)-Li2(1/z) is not the 4₁ state integral; #3854's A₁ mis-identified as the b-dictionary — the κ-tower is the physical object. Scope-(a) correction; no c_k wired.

description: Self-review correction of the merged Φ_b 2-loop (#3854/#3859). The saddle A₁ of V=Li2(z)-Li2(1/z) at z*=e^{iπ/3} is EXACT: A₁ = 1/3 + (17√3/108)i (50+ dps). But A₁ is NOT the 4₁ Ohtsuki 2-loop invariant κ₁ = 11√3π/108 (corpus Kashaev fit) under any standard normalization (ℏ=2πi/N gives A₁·2πi = −1.713+2.094i ≠ real κ₁; best rel match ~0.6). Since a correct 4₁ state integral's 2-loop equals the Ohtsuki κ₁ (Ohtsuki = perturbative-CS = state-integral loop expansion), V=Li2(z)-Li2(1/z) is NOT the 4₁ state integral — it matches Vol+torsion (the #3854 G1/G2 gates, necessary not sufficient) but diverges at 2-loop. CORRECTION (scope-(a), re-scope not delete): #3854's A₁ is a clean but MIS-IDENTIFIED object; the physical b-dictionary is the corpus κ-tower already derived. A₁↔d_k resolves: A₁ is not a loop invariant of the physical integral. No c_k wired; L2 2/7. Retires the Φ_b-2-loop b-dictionary line.
